statement: For independent standard Gaussian vertex weights on Z^2, let M_n be the maximum total weight over paths with n vertices starting at (0,0), with each step right or up and the endpoint free. Prove that there exist epsilon in (0,1) and C<infinity independent of n such that Var(M_n)<=C n^(1-epsilon) for all n>=2, improving the n/log n bound in Theorem 8.1 of the cited source.
